status: Owner equipment/continuity report; supply-only preparation proposed, not connected or tested.

identity.owner_description: Router number 1 of the C8235-G2 fleet, clip on U2900
identity.fresh_serial_and_isolation_confirmation: Owner replied confirmed to grouped chassis FGL2835L42B, board FOC28292GUQ, router power/console/USB/network/coin-cell disconnected and Pi USB-C unplugged question. Accept these explicitly listed conditions; no new assembly/cooling or console process check performed.

bench_supply.ocp_vs_cc_behavior: Manufacturer manual documents separate adjustable current limit and adjustable OCP trip; actual low-current behavior of this unit untested.

owner_report.pi: Owner confirms Pi USB-C unplugged and clip not connected to Pi.
owner_report.measurement_limits: OUTPUT interpreted in prior adapter/harness numbering, not physical flash numbering. Fresh lead baseline, meter mode/range, residual DC and actual adapter attachment not separately reported.
owner_report.available: Breadboards and Dupont cables. Grouped confirmed answer does not clearly resolve whether old resistor branch/RESET grabber remains connected; selected preparation removes all old source paths and leaves RESET grabber free.

interpretation: New bench supply availability supersedes the November 1 no-bench-supply state; earlier observations remain historical.
Reported paths are consistent with established ground/VCC mapping. They do not measure VCC-to-ground resistance or establish load current, isolation, signal mapping or a safe 200 mA operating point.
J2507-8 maps to physical pin 2/VCC on both U2900 and U2901; J2507-2 maps to physical pin 10/VSS on both. This is a shared board supply, not verified flash-only isolation.
Prior source 1.793 V / board 0.423 V through measured 99 ohms implies about 13.8 mA only at that operating point; no extrapolation to 1.8 V load current.
Pi GPIO uses 3.3 V logic; the bench supply does not replace signal-level translation. The existing adapter has a regulator and translator; external supply must not be paralleled with its OUTPUT 8.

next_preparation.prerequisites: Identity and listed power/cable/coin-cell/Pi USB-C isolation confirmed. Preserve that state. Before handling confirm J2507-8 to 2 residual 0 V. Remove all Pi/adapter/CH341A-to-board paths, old parallel supply connections and any RESET resistor/ground connection. Keep RESET grabber free. No native router power; assembly/cooling state not newly restated.
next_preparation.first_topology: Supply-only: bench negative -> J2507-2/GND; bench positive -> existing isolated/measured nominal 100-ohm (previously 99-ohm) resistor -> J2507-8/VCC. Use separate breadboard strips for resistor legs. Clip may remain physically seated with entire cable/adapter connection electrically disconnected and free contacts insulated. All adapter/Pi/CH341A paths absent; U2901 RESET lead free.
next_preparation.settings: Jesverty OUT OFF, CHG and OPN disabled; normal voltage preset 1.80 V and normal current-limit preset 0.020 A. In separate OCP screen set 0.020 A and enable OCP. Keep series resistor for first comparison; 20 mA is a cautious diagnostic starting setting, not established safe/adequate operating current. With 99 ohms, ideal branch limit at 1.8 V is about 18.2 mA.
next_preparation.pending_measurements: With all router/Pi/adapter wiring absent, enable only supply output and verify DC voltage/polarity across red + / black - terminals (not green GND); report measured value, disable OUT and verify discharge. Only with near-1.80 V verified and board residual 0 V, assemble stated resistor-limited supply-only topology while output remains OFF. Report unloaded value and completed unpowered wiring; no powered board trial yet selected.
next_preparation.later_spi: Complete Pi/adapter/target wiring and power sequencing remain unqualified. Need stable loaded target rail within 1.7-2.0 V, understood load and a verified supply separation/translation arrangement before SPI. No automatic resistor bypass, current increase, RESET assertion or read.

performed_by_agent: Read-only local evidence/reference review and repository documentation only. No SSH, serial, GPIO, SPI, supply command, flash acquisition/write or router test.

owner_followup.adapter: Owner confirms prior use of the 1.8 V adapter, believes new supply removes need for it. Clarified that Pi 3.3 V SPI still needs 1.8 V translation; supply can replace target power only.

findings: Voltage resolution 0.01 V, current resolution 0.001 A; display accuracy 0.5% + 5 digits. This is not a calibrated low-current measurement of the target.
Normal A-COARSE/A-FINE settings govern CV/CC crossover; OCP screen separately adjusts trip point and enable state. OCP trips output off.
Output uses red positive and black negative. Green GND is a separate grounding terminal. Do not substitute it for output negative.
Manual presents automatic output OPN and battery-charge CHG modes; leave both disabled for this preparation.
manufacturer_manual_review.limitations: Manual does not establish connected board current, startup overshoot at 1.8 V or safe current injection into this shared rail.
